title: 2BR Beach House in Rosemary Beach with Beach Access
meta_description: Relax at Blue Oak, an elegant 2BR, 2BA beach house in Rosemary Beach, with 3 balconies, an elevator, private beach access, and 4 cruiser bikes. Sleeps 7.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• Professionally designed• A dedicated, covered parking space• Another parking spot is available with a permit on street.• Viking appliances• Three gorgeous balconies with sweeping, penthouse views• Easy walk to the beach and community pools• Private Elevator Access• 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser BikesPenthouse city living meets the casual luxury of an elegant beach house at this two-bedroom hideaway in Rosemary Beach. Located on the top floor of charming Barrett Place, you’ll experience the convenience of being effortlessly close to everything— including four gorgeous pools, dozens of delicious restaurants and casual cafes, eclectic boutique shopping, and a state-of-the-art fitness center. Best of all, the sugary white sandy beach and emerald green water of the Gulf of Mexico is only a five-minute stroll away.Park in the dedicated parking space in the covered garage and take the elevator up to the top floor of Barrett Place. Open the door to number 9 to reveal a crisp and bright living and dining space. In the living area, a neutral sleeper sofa and velvety soft armchairs face a bespoke built-in entertainment center. Classic white shiplap detail, gleaming hardwood floors, and recessed lighting add a laid-back polish, while glass French doors lead outside to a birds-eye-view balcony of bustling Rosemary Beach far below.The open dining area features a formal dining table with seating for six and a casual bar area with modern acrylic barstool seating for four. The whole area is illuminated by stylish pendant lights. In the kitchen, a full suite of premier Viking appliances creates a chic, efficient space for brewing a simple pot of coffee in the morning to preparing a full dinner on those evenings when you want to stay in. There’s also a laundry room with additional storage options.The two bedrooms are located on opposite ends of the living space and each has an ensuite bath— allowing for plenty of privacy and peace and ensuring a great night’s sleep for all. In the first bedroom, there’s a custom twin-over-queen bunk bed, swivel-mounted HDTV, a full bathroom with a tub/shower combo, and a sun-drenched balcony with a panoramic view. In the primary bedroom suite, you’ll find a sumptuous king-size bed, HDTV, and another sunny balcony with breathtaking views. In the primary ensuite bathroom, a massive step-in shower with multiple showerheads is the ideal space to rinse off after a sandy day at the beach.With tons of luxurious touches— like gorgeous Grohe faucets and fixtures and Viking appliances— no detail has been overlooked in the design of this sublime penthouse suite. Your family will love the convenience of the central location, yet you’ll enjoy the quiet peace and privacy of being in your own world high above the hustle and bustle below. This soaring hideaway strikes the perfect balance between a chic city retreat and an elegant, laid-back beach house.HOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 7)• Open LIVING and DINING area with QUEEN sleeper sofa• Fully-equipped KITCHEN• LAUNDRY room • Sunny BALCONY• KING SUITE with ensuite BATHROOM and BALCONY• BUNK ROOM with a twin-over-queen bunk, ensuite BATH, and BALCONYTDT-206194
